+

+
+S008 adds a clause forbidding each completion K5 in each layer, and a clause forbidding every input K3,3 subgraph in each layer. The first is necessary because K5 has10 edges on5 vertices, exceeding planar Euler9. The second is necessary because its bipartite9-edge subgraph on6 vertices exceeds the bipartite planar bound8; optional edges inside either triple are irrelevant, since the cross-edge subgraph alone is nonplanar. Neither family enumerates all Kuratowski subdivisions or gives a SAT converse.
+
+All completion five-sets are enumerated; all input K3,3s are enumerated as two disjoint triples. Implementation chooses triple A and triple B from its common input neighbours, with min(A)<min(B). Every unordered six-vertex triple partition satisfying all nine cross edges appears exactly once, since the smallest label fixes its part. No graph-isomorphism reduction, extra first-edge unit or deficit-specific assumption is added. These cuts hold for every actual completion and all its automorphism images. Thus choosing the inherited common-order orbit minimum preserves the existing lex constraints even when bag partitions are not invariant.
+
+All new clauses are evaluated directly against27 frozen actual completions, independently rechecking each sphere rotation/LR planarity. This includes23 small/strong controls, three actual D2 edge-deletion examples and the42v disjoint-triangulation witness. They check implementation obligations, not universal necessity by testing. +# Simultaneous extension through heavy cores
+
+Work only under actual12-critical biplanar hypotheses. Keep actual neighbour sets distinct from palettes. This route tries to replace local spare-colour manipulations with an exact simultaneous extension test; it does not establish that the test can always be met.
+
+Let T_1,...,T_t be disjoint heavy K8 noncut cores as in S008_SHARED_SUPPORT and F=G-(union T_i). For any actual proper11-colouring phi of F, set
+
+    P_i=phi(A_i union {z_i}).
+
+Every vertex in T_i has precisely that exterior neighbourhood and T_i is K7. There are no edges between different T_i. Therefore phi extends through ALL cores if and only if |P_i|<=4 for EVERY i. Necessity: seven distinct core colours must avoid P_i. Sufficiency: independently choose any seven distinct colours in {1,...,11} minus P_i for each clique. Other low vertices stay coloured in F; the z_i are outside the removed noncut cores, even when the block structure is a two-endblock component. No unreviewed contraction or shared planar embedding is used.
+
+Criticality gives some colouring of F (a proper subgraph). Since G is12-critical, EVERY such colouring must have at least one i with |P_i|=5. It need not be the same i in different colourings. For t=1 this recovers the local obstruction; for t>1 it exposes the exact simultaneous obligation. One cannot infer that every block is bad in every exterior colouring from its individual-deletion theorem: F deletes more than one core.
+
+To attack that obligation, take an uncoloured subset R of the exterior and define available colours L(v)={1,...,11} minus phi(N_F(v) minus R). Recolouring R is exactly proper list colouring of F[R] with lists L. Merely selecting one distinct support vertex per block (Hall) supplies no control of these lists. If R is independent, its individual assignments are unconstrained by adjacency, but the desired repeated-boundary colours couple assignments across blocks. If R has edges, Hall's matching condition describes the special sufficient tactic of assigning all of R distinct colours; it is not necessary for arbitrary proper list colouring and does not force the boundary repetitions we need.
+
+The registered exhaustive512 availability triples over a three-colour universe check the elementary distinct-assignment Hall condition by independent permutation enumeration (247 admit an assignment). The explicit triple L_1=L_2=L_3={0,1} admits distinct assignments on every pair but none on all three. This is an abstract palette obstruction, not a12-critical biplanar graph or counterexample to a universal theorem. It falsifies replacing the simultaneous list obligation by pairwise checks. Conversely an independent triple with those same lists can all receive0: requiring distinct colours would introduce an unnecessary restriction. Both directions must be kept separate.
+
+Other attempts remain blocked: identifying nonadjacent boundary vertices can destroy either layer's planarity (CLM0013); two-layer Kempe chains can switch layers; no degree upper bound on high vertices exists; deleting a single low component proves chi(G-C)=11 but does not force chi(H)=11 when L has several components. Published SRC0027's good-colouring budget treats unequal actual neighbourhoods, not arbitrary heavy repeated sets. No valid all-order contradiction for heavy components/large deficit was found. The exact extension criterion is a necessary research reformulation and is not a universal colouring theorem, headline bound advance or novelty claim.
+
+## Heavy odd-cycle endblocks: remaining lengths and support
+
+This paper route uses the same published blocking-count method, with no extra computation. Let an odd-cycle endblock B=C_r (r>=5) have one low cut vertex z and a common actual high-neighbour set A for all its r-1 noncut vertices. Each noncut vertex has internal degree2 and total degree11, so |A|=9. Delete z from B. The noncut path has r-1 vertices, r-2 edges and9(r-1) edges to A. The inherited biplanar subgraph has n=r+8,m=10r-11; Euler yields4r<=47, hence r<=11. If a whole low component is C_r with identical actual exterior A, its r core vertices/9 high vertices give n=r+9,m=10r and4r<=42, hence r<=9. These are all-order necessary bounds, not decisions that the surviving local graphs are biplanar.
+
+For any independent Z subset A, |Z|=q>=2, criticality also forces
+
+    sum_Z(deg_G(a)-12) >= (r-2)q-11
+
+in the endblock case. Indeed colour G-T with11 colours, where T is the noncut path. If some colour can simultaneously recolour two vertices of Z while the rest of G-T stays fixed, A ceases to be rainbow. At most8 colours then appear on A, leaving at least3 for T. Only the two path endpoints additionally meet z; removing its colour leaves each endpoint at least2 available colours, and internal vertices at least3. Greedily colour the path from one endpoint to the other, excluding the predecessor's colour each time: the final endpoint still has at least one choice. This extends the exterior colouring, contradicting criticality.

For a whole heavy odd-cycle component, recolouring a pair leaves3 available colours for an odd cycle (which has an explicit3-colouring); the same count with r core neighbours gives (r-1)q-11 instead. No clique-colouring requirement was imposed on the path. The argument does not require a spare colour: it proves how much blocking MUST occur if such a simultaneous recolouring is impossible.

These conditions permit arbitrarily many blocks and concentrated/overlapping excess. +# Heavy K8 supports: all-order expansion and its limits
+
+Target: an actual finite simple12-critical biplanar G. Use the source-stated Gallai theorem (SRC0027), classical K9 exclusion (SRC0014) and S007's proved heavy-endblock prerequisites. No universal11-colouring theorem or novelty is asserted.
+
+Let B_i be heavy K8 endblocks with a genuine cut vertex z_i, T_i their seven noncut vertices and A_i their four common neighbours in H. Each T_i induces K7, each A_i is independent by K9 exclusion, and every vertex of T_i has neighbourhood (T_i minus itself) union {z_i} union A_i. Distinct K8 low blocks cannot meet: a common vertex would have low degree at least14>11. Thus T_i are pairwise disjoint, and no edges join different T_i (a noncut low vertex lies in only its own block). The sets A_i consist of high vertices and are disjoint from all these low cores.

+"""CAM-0009 completion K5 and input K3,3 necessary full-layer clauses."""
+import itertools
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from s007_cover import StrongCover
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+
+
+def obstructions(n, edges):
+    original = set(edges)
+    for vs in itertools.combinations(range(n), 5):
+        yield 'K5', tuple(itertools.combinations(vs, 2))
+    adj={v:set() for v in range(n)}
+    for u,v in original:adj[u].add(v);adj[v].add(u)
+    for a in itertools.combinations(range(n), 3):
+        common=set.intersection(*(adj[v] for v in a))-set(a)
+        for b in itertools.combinations(sorted(common),3):
+            # Canonical part contains the smallest of the six labels.
+            if min(a)<min(b):
+                cross=tuple(sorted(tuple(sorted((u,v))) for u in a for v in b))
+                yield 'K33',cross
+
+
+class FullCover(StrongCover):
+    def __init__(self, edges, lex=False, short_links=False):
+        super().__init__(edges, lex, short_links)
+        counts = {'K5': 0, 'K33': 0}
+        for kind, es in obstructions(self.n, edges):
+            counts[kind] += 1
+            for layer in range(2):
+                self.base.append([-self.E(layer, *e) for e in es])
+        self.static.update(s008_version='completion-K5-input-K33-v1', s008_counts=counts)
+
+
+def main():
+    if sys.argv[1] == 'check':
+        _, _, ef, prefix = sys.argv
+        d = json.loads(Path(prefix+'.cuts.json').read_text())
+        c = FullCover(read_edges(ef), d['lex'], d.get('short_links', False))
+        assert c.static == d['static']
+        c.cuts = d['cuts']
+        c.write_cnf(Path(prefix+'.regenerated.cnf'))
+        assert Path(prefix+'.cnf').read_bytes() == Path(prefix+'.regenerated.cnf').read_bytes()
+        print('PASS S008 cold necessary CNF/cuts regeneration')
+    else:
+        _, ef, prefix, seconds, *flags = sys.argv
+        c = FullCover(read_edges(ef), '--lex' in flags)
+        # Save static metadata before solve(), which may block until external cap.
+        import time
+        c.save(prefix, 'INITIALISED', 0, time.monotonic())
+        c.write_cnf(Path(prefix+'.initial.cnf'))
+        print(json.dumps(c.static), flush=True)
+        print(json.dumps(c.run(prefix, float(seconds))), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+import json

+from pathlib import Path

+

+cmd=['powershell.exe','-NoProfile','-Command',
+    "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'python.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 's008_(run|cover|tree_run|tree)\\.py' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3"]
+r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8');assert r.returncode==0
+processes=json.loads(r.stdout or '[]')
+if isinstance(processes,dict):processes=[processes]
+parents={}
+for p in processes:
+    line=p['CommandLine'].replace('\\','/')
+    if re.search(r'tools/s008_run\.py search(?:\s|$)',line):parents[p['ProcessId']]='sequential'
+    if re.search(r'tools/s008_tree_run\.py(?:\s|$)',line):parents[p['ProcessId']]='tree'
+events=json.loads((root/'redundant_stops.json').read_text()) if (root/'redundant_stops.json').exists() else []
+for p in processes:

+    lane=parents[p['ParentProcessId']];line=p['CommandLine'].replace('\\','/')
+    expected='s008_cover' if lane=='sequential' else 's008_tree'
+    if not re.search(r'tools/'+expected+r'\.py ',line) or ' check ' in line:continue
+    match=re.search(r'targets/row(\d+)\.edges',line)
+    if not match:continue
+    idx=int(match.group(1));other='tree' if lane=='sequential' else 'sequential'
+    folder=root/'tree' if other=='tree' else root
+    result=folder/'search_results.json'
+    if not result.exists():continue
+    candidates=json.loads(result.read_text())
+    known=next((x for x in candidates if x['target']['index']==idx and x['verdict']=='NON_BIPLANAR_DRAT_VERIFIED'),None)
+    if not known:continue
+    cert=known['certificate'];ef=root/'targets'/f'row{idx}.edges'
+    assert known['target']['edge_sha256']==sha(ef)
+    assert sha(cert['archive'])==cert['archive_sha256']
+    assert cert['check']['returncode']==cert['cold_retained_check']['returncode']==0
+    assert 's VERIFIED' in Path(str(folder/'search'/f'cover-row{idx}')+'.check.log').read_text()
+    assert 's VERIFIED' in Path(str(folder/'search'/f'cover-row{idx}')+'.cold.check.log').read_text()
+    work=Path('artifacts/tmp/S008')/('tree' if lane=='tree' else '')/'search'/f'cover-row{idx}'
+    meta=Path(str(work)+'.result.json');log=Path(str(work)+'.run.log')

+    if json.loads(meta.read_text())['verdict'] not in ('INITIALISED','RUNNING'):continue
+    assert Path(str(work)+'.initial.cnf').exists()
+    kill=['taskkill.exe','/PID',str(int(p['ProcessId'])),'/T','/F']
+    action=subprocess.run(kill,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)

+        observed_command=p['CommandLine'],stop_command=kill,returncode=action.returncode,stdout=action.stdout,stderr=action.stderr,

+checks=0

+    lits=list(range(1,n+1))
+    for bound in range(n+1):
+        for relation in ('atmost','atleast','equals'):
+            pool=IDPool(start_from=n+1)
+            cnf=getattr(TreeCardEnc,relation)(lits=lits,bound=bound,vpool=pool)

+                    truth=sum(bits)
+                    expected={'atmost':truth<=bound,'atleast':truth>=bound,'equals':truth==bound}[relation]
+                    actual=solver.solve(assumptions=[v if bit else -v for v,bit in zip(lits,bits)])
+                    assert actual==expected
+                    checks+=1
+rows=[]

+import gzip
+import hashlib
+import json
+import random
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+from blowup_chi_cnf import bag_cnf
+from check_layers import main as check_split
+from s004_certify import write_cnf
+from triangulation_cover import Cover
+
+
+def sha(p):
+    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def main():
+    out = Path('validation/S008')
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    scratch = Path('artifacts/tmp/S008/replay')
+    scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    checker = str(Path('artifacts/tmp/S004/drat-trim-mingw.exe').resolve())
+    rows = []
+    start = time.monotonic()
+    specs = [
+        ('K9', 'validation/S003/K9.edges',
+         'validation/S004/controls/cover-K9',
+         'validation/S004/controls/cover-K9.drat.gz', 600),
+        ('row165', 'validation/S004/targets/full-min-survivor.edges',
+         'validation/S004/search/cover-full-min-survivor',
+         'validation/S004/full-obstruction-core.drat.gz', 1200)]
+    for tag, edgefile, prefix, proof_archive, cap in specs:
+        cnf = scratch / (tag+'.cnf')
+        proof = scratch / (tag+'.drat')
+        cnf.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(prefix+'.cnf.gz').read_bytes()))
+        proof.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(proof_archive).read_bytes()))
+        data = json.loads(Path(prefix+'.cuts.json').read_text())
+        c = Cover(read_edges(edgefile), data['lex'], data.get('short_links', False))
+        c.cuts = data['cuts']
+        regen = scratch / (tag+'.regenerated.cnf')
+        c.write_cnf(regen)
+        assert regen.read_bytes() == cnf.read_bytes()
+        if tag == 'row165':
+            original = json.loads(Path('validation/S004/full_obstruction_compact_proof.json').read_text())
+            assert sha(proof) == original['raw_sha256']
+            assert sha(cnf) == original['cnf_sha256']
+        cmd = [checker, str(cnf), str(proof), '-t', str(cap)]
+        t = time.monotonic()
+        r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=cap+20)
+        log = out / (tag+'-replay.check.log')
+        log.write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr, newline='\n')
+        assert 's VERIFIED' in r.stdout, r.stdout+r.stderr
+        rows.append({'tag':tag, 'cuts':len(c.cuts), 'command':cmd,
+                     'cnf_sha256':sha(cnf), 'proof_sha256':sha(proof),
+                     'seconds':time.monotonic()-t, 'checker':'VERIFIED'})
+        (out/'replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=1), newline='\n')
+        print(tag, 'regeneration identical, DRAT VERIFIED', flush=True)
+    row = json.loads(Path('validation/S004/chi10_results.json').read_text())[165]
+    cnf = scratch/'row165-bag.cnf'
+    proof = scratch/'row165-bag.drat'
+    write_cnf(cnf, *bag_cnf(row['g6'], row['w'], 9))
+    proof.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(row['bag']['archive']).read_bytes()))
+    assert sha(cnf) == row['bag']['cnf_sha256']
+    assert sha(proof) == row['bag']['drat_sha256']
+    cmd = [checker, str(cnf), str(proof), '-t', '600']
+    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=620)
+    (out/'row165-bag.check.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr, newline='\n')
+    assert 's VERIFIED' in r.stdout
+    rows.append({'tag':'row165-bag', 'command':cmd, 'checker':'VERIFIED',
+                 'cnf_sha256':sha(cnf), 'proof_sha256':sha(proof)})
+    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'tools/check_s004_archives.py'],
+                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
+    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stdout+r.stderr
+    (out/'archive-audit.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr, newline='\n')
+    controls = []
+    rng = random.Random(5005)
+    import itertools
+    for idx in range(20):
+        n = rng.randrange(4, 9)
+        edges = {tuple(sorted((v, (v+1)%n))) for v in range(n)}
+        p = rng.random()
+        edges.update(e for e in itertools.combinations(range(n), 2) if rng.random() < p)
+        target = scratch/f'control-{idx:02d}'
+        result = Cover(sorted(edges), lex=True).run(str(target), 30)
+        assert result['verdict'] == 'SAT_CHECKED'
+        edgefile = str(target)+'.edges'
+        Path(edgefile).write_text(''.join(f'{a} {b}\n' for a,b in sorted(edges)), newline='\n')
+        check_split(edgefile, str(target)+'.split.json')
+        controls.append({'index':idx, 'n':n, 'm':len(edges), **result})
+    for tag in ('K8', 'sulanke', 'K9e'):
+        edgefile = f'validation/S003/splits/{tag}.edges'
+        prefix = str(scratch/('control-'+tag))
+        result = Cover(read_edges(edgefile), lex=True).run(prefix, 30)
+        assert result['verdict'] == 'SAT_CHECKED'
+        check_split(edgefile, prefix+'.split.json')
+        controls.append({'tag':tag, **result})
+    (out/'replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=1), newline='\n')
+    (out/'controls.json').write_text(json.dumps({'seed':5005, 'results':controls,
+        'seconds_total':time.monotonic()-start}, indent=1), newline='\n')
+    print('PASS cold archives and 23 positive controls', flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+    assert hashes == old['native_sha256']
+    pins = {}
+    for name, pin in old['native_sources'].items():
+        source = Path('artifacts/tmp/S004')/name
+        got = subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(source),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
+        status = subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(source),'status','--porcelain'],text=True)
+        assert got == pin and not status
+        pins[name] = got
+    save(ROOT/'environment.json',dict(python=sys.version,platform=platform.platform(),
+        networkx=networkx.__version__,python_sat=pysat.__version__,native_sha256=hashes,
+        native_sources=pins,build='S004 reused; no build'))
+    # Reuse inherited baseline without writing to any previous session.
+    text = Path('tools/s005_replay.py').read_text().replace("'validation/S005'", "'validation/S008'")
+    text = text.replace("'artifacts/tmp/S005/replay'", "'artifacts/tmp/S008/replay'")
+    text = 'import sys\nsys.path.insert(0, '+repr(str(Path('tools').resolve()))+')\n'+text
+    adapter = TMP/'baseline.py'; adapter.write_text(text, newline='\n')
+    save(ROOT/'baseline_launch_hash.json',dict(path=str(adapter),sha256=sha(adapter)))
+    run = run_logged([sys.executable,str(adapter)],2400,ROOT/'baseline.log')
+    save(ROOT/'baseline_command.json',run)
+    assert run['returncode'] == 0
+    cold=[]

+            pool=IDPool(start_from=n+1)

+import sys
+sys.path.insert(0, 'C:\\Earth-Moon-problem\\tools')
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""CAM-0006 cold controls, regenerated CNFs, and actual certificate replay."""
+import gzip
+import hashlib
+import json
+import random
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+from blowup_chi_cnf import bag_cnf
+from check_layers import main as check_split
+from s004_certify import write_cnf
+from triangulation_cover import Cover
+
+
+def sha(p):
+    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def main():
+    out = Path('validation/S008')
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    scratch = Path('artifacts/tmp/S008/replay')
+    scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    checker = str(Path('artifacts/tmp/S004/drat-trim-mingw.exe').resolve())
+    rows = []
+    start = time.monotonic()
+    specs = [
+        ('K9', 'validation/S003/K9.edges',
+         'validation/S004/controls/cover-K9',
+         'validation/S004/controls/cover-K9.drat.gz', 600),
+        ('row165', 'validation/S004/targets/full-min-survivor.edges',
+         'validation/S004/search/cover-full-min-survivor',
+         'validation/S004/full-obstruction-core.drat.gz', 1200)]
+    for tag, edgefile, prefix, proof_archive, cap in specs:
+        cnf = scratch / (tag+'.cnf')
+        proof = scratch / (tag+'.drat')
+        cnf.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(prefix+'.cnf.gz').read_bytes()))
+        proof.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(proof_archive).read_bytes()))
+        data = json.loads(Path(prefix+'.cuts.json').read_text())
+        c = Cover(read_edges(edgefile), data['lex'], data.get('short_links', False))
+        c.cuts = data['cuts']
+        regen = scratch / (tag+'.regenerated.cnf')
+        c.write_cnf(regen)
+        assert regen.read_bytes() == cnf.read_bytes()
+        if tag == 'row165':
+            original = json.loads(Path('validation/S004/full_obstruction_compact_proof.json').read_text())
+            assert sha(proof) == original['raw_sha256']
+            assert sha(cnf) == original['cnf_sha256']
+        cmd = [checker, str(cnf), str(proof), '-t', str(cap)]
+        t = time.monotonic()
+        r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=cap+20)
+        log = out / (tag+'-replay.check.log')
+        log.write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr, newline='\n')
+        assert 's VERIFIED' in r.stdout, r.stdout+r.stderr
+        rows.append({'tag':tag, 'cuts':len(c.cuts), 'command':cmd,
+                     'cnf_sha256':sha(cnf), 'proof_sha256':sha(proof),
+                     'seconds':time.monotonic()-t, 'checker':'VERIFIED'})
+        (out/'replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=1), newline='\n')
+        print(tag, 'regeneration identical, DRAT VERIFIED', flush=True)
+    row = json.loads(Path('validation/S004/chi10_results.json').read_text())[165]
+    cnf = scratch/'row165-bag.cnf'
+    proof = scratch/'row165-bag.drat'
+    write_cnf(cnf, *bag_cnf(row['g6'], row['w'], 9))
+    proof.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(row['bag']['archive']).read_bytes()))
+    assert sha(cnf) == row['bag']['cnf_sha256']
+    assert sha(proof) == row['bag']['drat_sha256']
+    cmd = [checker, str(cnf), str(proof), '-t', '600']
+    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=620)
+    (out/'row165-bag.check.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr, newline='\n')
+    assert 's VERIFIED' in r.stdout
+    rows.append({'tag':'row165-bag', 'command':cmd, 'checker':'VERIFIED',
+                 'cnf_sha256':sha(cnf), 'proof_sha256':sha(proof)})
+    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'tools/check_s004_archives.py'],
+                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
+    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stdout+r.stderr
+    (out/'archive-audit.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr, newline='\n')
+    controls = []
+    rng = random.Random(5005)
+    import itertools
+    for idx in range(20):
+        n = rng.randrange(4, 9)
+        edges = {tuple(sorted((v, (v+1)%n))) for v in range(n)}
+        p = rng.random()
+        edges.update(e for e in itertools.combinations(range(n), 2) if rng.random() < p)
+        target = scratch/f'control-{idx:02d}'
+        result = Cover(sorted(edges), lex=True).run(str(target), 30)
+        assert result['verdict'] == 'SAT_CHECKED'
+        edgefile = str(target)+'.edges'
+        Path(edgefile).write_text(''.join(f'{a} {b}\n' for a,b in sorted(edges)), newline='\n')
+        check_split(edgefile, str(target)+'.split.json')
+        controls.append({'index':idx, 'n':n, 'm':len(edges), **result})
+    for tag in ('K8', 'sulanke', 'K9e'):
+        edgefile = f'validation/S003/splits/{tag}.edges'
+        prefix = str(scratch/('control-'+tag))
+        result = Cover(read_edges(edgefile), lex=True).run(prefix, 30)
+        assert result['verdict'] == 'SAT_CHECKED'
+        check_split(edgefile, prefix+'.split.json')
+        controls.append({'tag':tag, **result})
+    (out/'replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=1), newline='\n')
+    (out/'controls.json').write_text(json.dumps({'seed':5005, 'results':controls,
+        'seconds_total':time.monotonic()-start}, indent=1), newline='\n')
+    print('PASS cold archives and 23 positive controls', flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
